displayName: OCI-DB-MSS-002: SQL Server — SUSPENDED Login State Anomaly
description:
Detects SQL Server logins in SUSPENDED state indicating potential credential abuse

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: sql server — suspended login state anomaly

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_db_mss_002", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%sql%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%server%') AND "value" > 0
